description: "Beauty: Illustrated Chiefly by an Analysis and Classification of Beauty in Woman" by Alexander Walker is a scientific publication written in the mid-19th century. The work delves into the philosophical principles surrounding beauty, particularly focusing on its analysis and classification as it pertains to women and how it intersects with anatomy and psychology.
